name: Hubble Space Telescope

source.publisher: NASA Visualization Technology Applications and Development (VTAD) — https://science.nasa.gov/resource/hubble-space-telescope-3d-model-2/

processing.method: node hierarchy baked (incl. per-node scale via inverse-transpose normal matrices); vertex-cluster decimation (grid 144, material+normal-octant keyed); per-vertex colors sampled from the real base-color textures (nearest texel at each vertex UV × baseColorFactor) — derived from the NASA asset, nothing invented

honesty: Decimated derivative of NASA's official Hubble model for focused-object display (~72–150 px). Geometry and colors are simplified from the source asset; this is a real model of the real telescope, not a class-representative form.
